speaker: suspect
text: I want to speak to my lawyer. I don’t want to answer any more questions.

speaker: officer
text: We’ll deal with that later. First, explain those marks on your hands. Did you hurt Donald?

speaker: suspect
text: I already told you. I want a lawyer.

speaker: officer
text: This is your opportunity to help yourself. Cooperate with me, and I can try to make things easier for you.

speaker: suspect
text: I don’t want to keep talking without a lawyer.

speaker: officer
text: If you won’t cooperate, you could face the most serious charges. Tell me what happened.

speaker: suspect
text: Why do you keep asking? I said I want a lawyer.

speaker: officer
text: Donald was your friend. You cared about him. Help me understand what happened.

speaker: narrator
text: The first interview ends without a confession. Neal is held overnight without access to a lawyer, food, or water. The following morning, he asks to speak with the detective again.

speaker: officer
text: You wanted to talk to me. What do you want to tell me?

speaker: suspect
text: I want to tell you what happened. I killed Donald.

speaker: officer
text: Tell me what happened between you.

speaker: suspect
text: We had argued earlier. I got angry, and I killed him.
